stages.terminal_condition: All 12 IDs, one-axis overrides, common center parameters, fold plan, no-control risk state, and materialization recipe are frozen before reading the center result.
The registered center passes every no-control activation threshold in qualification_thresholds.json; otherwise stop without running neighbors.
Every predeclared neighbor has separate executable strategy/config bytes, complete source manifest, semantic review, and registration; all 12 registrations precede the first neighbor result.
All 12 registered neighbors are evaluated chronologically with identical folds, seed rule, no-control risk bytes, and paired base/doubled costs; no early stopping or subset replacement is allowed.
The organizer binds every parameter and daily-return artifact and computes profitable fraction, median Sharpe, and positive-PnL concentration once for qualification.
